# Candidate whole-briefing evaluation fixtures

Seven human-authored variants of the saved synthesis, for review before evaluation.
These are generated semantic claims and authored synthesis prose, not publisher bodies.
No production runtime file is changed. No runner or live evaluation is implemented.

Every fixture preserves all source metadata, claims, reference identities and ordering.
The original model/timestamp/request_bytes fields are retained provenance of the base
snapshot, not claims that these edited fixtures were generated by that model or that
these are their current request sizes. Measure each future request independently.

`manifest.json` contains human labels and hashes. Never include it, case IDs, labels
or mutation descriptions in model input. Supply only a fixture through the existing
verifier request builder. Labels remain candidates pending human review.

Clean repairs: narrow overview's policy framing to Europe/Türkiye; remove the first
theme title's implied causal link; state Argentina price movements separately; replace
ECB's contrast with coexistence; remove Türkiye's only-if/otherwise and unused a3:c3
citation; omit Swedish-data detail; explicitly frame the BIS implication as our inference
and add a5:c1/c2 support; replace Republican Senate retention with winning the Senate.

Each defect variant changes one target only. Türkiye intentionally bundles the two
related conditionality mutations from the original sentence. BIS changes references
only, leaving its cautiously framed inference intact. ECB/BIS labels are review cases,
not hard correctness ground truth. The paraphrase variant changes three targets without
changing their references. Offline checks establish structure and mutation isolation,
not semantic correctness or model detection sensitivity.
